name: Kusabi Tetsugorou
source:
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 2
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colt_Officer's_ACP]Colt Officer's ACP[/url]

Out of loyalty to veteran detective [url=/[c99716]Kotobuki[/url], he joined the Heinous Crimes Unit upon its establishment.

He sometimes acts as [url=/c81096]Sumio's[/url] stopper, and sometimes troubles the younger agents with his explosive behavior. 

More afraid of being hated by his daughter than anything else in the world. Kusabi is seriously considering quitting smoking. 

Currently, his biggest source of worry is his eldest daughter Toriko's overseas studies.

[From the in-game profile]
